}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "DRM42L2 V1.3" and "08-04DRM4213" are silkscreened on the board.
It's a 4-bay 1U Rackmount NAS. This device has 2x USB 3.0 and 1x eSATA ports. {{See also|Synology RackStation RS812|Synology RackStation RS816|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] MV78260 Dual-core @1.33GHz (''Armada XP'' ARM v7) *Memory: 1GB (SDRAM) DDR3 *Storage: 8MB SPI NOR Flash, 4x SATA II, 1x eSATA *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: ~100-240V, 3.5A via C13
